info.title: track-record machine API
info.description: Benchmark results store. See docs/requirements.md for the FR/NFR ids referenced in operation descriptions.

post.summary: Aggregates across samples per run, case and client device (FR-12).
Compare side by side along a dimension (FR-16), streamed (NFR-7).
post.description:
The response is NDJSON: a `start` event, `progress` events, one `row`
event per matching key, and `done` (or `error`) last.

post.summary:
Export per-sample values or aggregates as CSV, NDJSON or Parquet
(FR-20), streamed.

Aggregate series across samples per run, case and device: percentiles
per grid point, e.g. a median with a band (FR-19).

Overlay series of many samples, optionally resampled onto a common grid
(FR-19).
Trend of a case, metric and client device across runs (FR-18).

get.summary: Annotations, filtered by run, test case or time range.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Point-in-time annotations at or after this time.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Point-in-time annotations before this time.

post.summary: Create an annotation on a run, a test case or a point in time.

get.summary: Case execution with samples, measurements and series metadata.

post.summary: Run a chart spec (FR-22, FR-23), streamed (NFR-7).
post.description:
The response is NDJSON: a `start` event, `progress` events, one
`result` with the tree that reaches the visualization (or the node
`until` names), then `done`, or `error` if the run fails after it
started. With `format`, the response is instead the file of the data
that reaches the visualization (FR-20): text/csv, application/x-ndjson
or application/vnd.apache.parquet.

200.description: NDJSON stream of events; with `format`, the file of the data that reaches the visualization: CSV, NDJSON with one object per row (not events) or Parquet

post.summary:
Check a chart spec: whether it is well-formed and valid, its problems
per node and setting, and the columns, attributes and group levels of
each node (ADR 0022, "Spec"). Problems are part of the answer.

get.summary: Client devices with their names after aliases.

post.summary:
Evaluate an expression or a saved derived metric on the samples of a
case execution.
Validate a DSL expression (FR-17a): syntax, references and units.
post.description:
Always 200; `valid` says whether it passed, `diagnostics` point at the
problems by byte offset.

get.summary: An environment (shared environment or device details).

Uploaded metrics. A metric has one definition, which can be changed in
the web UI; there are no versions (FR-7).
List runs, newest measured start first (FR-11).

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Run id; repeat for several.

parameters.name: suite
parameters.description: Suite name.

parameters.name: started_after
parameters.description: Measured start time at or after this time.

parameters.name: started_before
parameters.description: Measured start time before this time.

parameters.name: started_within_days
parameters.description:
Measured start within the last N days (at least 1), counted from the
server's time at the request.

parameters.name: latest_runs
parameters.description:
Of the runs that match all other conditions, only the N (at least 1)
with the newest measured start. `limit` and `cursor` page through them.

parameters.name: since_tag
parameters.description:
Measured start at or after that of the earliest run with this run tag.
The marked run is looked up among all runs, whatever the other
conditions say; 422 if no run has the tag.

parameters.name: since_sut_tag
parameters.description:
Measured start at or after that of the earliest run whose SUT version
has this tag, e.g. a release. Looked up among all runs, whatever the
other conditions say; 422 if no run has the tag.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status; repeat for several.

parameters.name: client_device
parameters.description: Client device name after aliases.

parameters.name: scenario
parameters.description: Scenario name.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Asset name.

parameters.name: param
parameters.description:
Parameter filter `name=value`, repeatable. The value is read as JSON
(`size=10` is a number, `mode="10"` a string); anything that is not a
JSON scalar is a string (`mode=fast`).

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric name with a measurement or series in the run.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag; repeat to require several.

parameters.name: validity
parameters.description: Valid runs by default (FR-9).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 500 (default 50).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page.

get.summary: Run detail with tags, annotations and attachments.

put.description: Idempotent: the same content again returns 200, different content 409.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Client-generated run id

200.description: Run already existed with this content

put.description:
`Content-Type` is stored for download. With `X-Content-SHA256` (hex) the
body is checked. Same id and content again returns 200.

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: Original file name, used only for download (never as a path).

parameters.name: case_execution_id
parameters.description: Case execution of the run the file belongs to.

parameters.name: sample_id
parameters.description: Sample of that case execution the file belongs to.

parameters.name: X-Content-SHA256
parameters.description: Expected SHA-256, hex

get.summary: Case executions of a run. Superseded ones are hidden by default.

parameters.name: include_superseded
parameters.description: Include case executions replaced by a correction.

put.summary: Add a case execution, optionally with its samples and series.
put.description:
The whole request is one transaction. New case executions need a running
run; corrections (`supersedes_id`) may be added to finished runs.

409.description: Conflicting content, the run is not running, or a metric exists with another unit or value type

put.summary: Add a sample, optionally with its series.

409.description: Conflicting content, or a metric exists with another unit or value type

put.summary: Add a series to a sample. The series and all points are one transaction.

409.description: Conflicting content, or a metric exists with another unit or value type

post.summary: Close a run with its final status.
post.description:
Sending the same status again is a no-op. A run that was aborted for
inactivity cannot be closed (409).

409.description: Run already has another terminal status

put.summary: Add a tag to a run. Adding an existing tag is a no-op.

delete.summary: Remove a tag from a run.

get.summary: Points of a series, optionally downsampled for display (FR-19).

parameters.name: max_points
parameters.description:
Downsample for display to at most this many points, keeping the
minimum and maximum of each bucket (FR-19). At least 2.

parameters.name: scenario
parameters.description: Scenario name.

put.summary: Add a tag to a test case.

delete.summary: Remove a tag from a test case.

confidence.description: Level of the confidence interval; default 0.95.

filter.description: Run filter (FR-11). `limit` and `cursor` do not apply.

include_warmup.description: Include warmup samples (FR-12; excluded by default).

metric.description:
The metric: an uploaded scalar metric (`load_time`), a derived metric
(`derived.throughput`) or any scalar DSL expression.

groups.description: One group per run, case and client device, in run order.

target.description: Current target; `null` if the alias was removed.

Annotation.description:
A free-text note on exactly one of: a run, a test case or a point in
time.

AttrJson.description:
The value of an attribute and its unit (absent for none). Times are
RFC 3339 text; parameters keep their JSON type.

device_details.description: Details of the client device for this execution.

superseded_by.description: Set if a correction replaced this case execution.

CaseInfo.description: A case: scenario version, assets and parameters after aliases.

parameters.description:
Parameters after aliases (only those in the matching key, for a
comparison).

test_case_ids.description:
Test cases that make up this case; several when aliases merge
parameter values.

excluded_parameters.description: Values of the parameters taken out of the matching key, as objects.

node.description: The node whose output the result is.

partial.description:
The result is not the whole chart: a preview, or a node other
than the visualization.

sources.description: The sources the run reads, with the samples each selected.

oneOf.description: Samples of all sources loaded so far.

excluded.description:
Samples left out per source because its metric does not apply
to them.

oneOf.description:
The run failed after it started. `node` and `setting` say where,
for an error of a node.

ChartEvent.description:
One line of the NDJSON stream of a chart run: `start`, `progress`, one
`result`, then `done` or `error`.

ChartFrame.description: An ordered list of points with the same columns.

input.description: The input of a match the frame came from.

ChartGroup.description: A group: the attributes it was formed by and its members.

ChartLine.description: A `ChartEvent`, or with `format: json` a row of the file: attributes and columns by name.

ChartPoint.description:
A point: one value per column (null for no value), and the attributes
in which it differs from its frame.

ChartProblem.description: One problem of a spec or of a run.

node.description: Id of the node; none for a problem of the whole spec.

setting.description:
Path of the setting, e.g. `filter.sut_branch`, `functions[1]` or
`variables[0].default`.

start.description:
Byte offsets of the part of the setting's expression, as the DSL
reports them.

ChartTree.description: What a node returns: a list of frames, or of groups.

frames.description: The frames, in order; absent when the tree is a list of groups.

groups.description: The groups, in order; absent when the tree is a list of frames.

ChartValidation.description: The problems of a spec and the output of each node.

nodes.description: The output of each node whose inputs could be checked, by node id.

valid.description: The spec can be run: well-formed and without problems.

well_formed.description:
The spec can be saved: known node types and settings, unique ids,
inputs that exist, no cycle, one visualization, within the limits.

details.description:
Device details (model, OS, driver, build). A change is marked in
trends but does not split them.

name.description: Stable name of the device, e.g. `pixel-8-lab-1`.

ended_at.description: Measured end time; defaults to now.

unit.description:
`""` for no unit; null if the unit is known only when the chart
runs.

oneOf.description: Latest run vs. the reference cell's latest run.

not_computable.description:
True if this cell or the reference has no value, so no difference
can be computed (FR-12a).

runs.description: One aggregate per run, oldest first. The last is the one compared.

shared_environment_differs.description: The latest run has another shared environment than the reference's.

sut_version_differs.description: The latest run has another SUT version than the reference's.

value.description: The dimension value of this column.

CompareEvent.description: One line of the NDJSON stream.

exclude_from_key.description: Parameters taken out of the matching key.

filter.description: Runs to compare (FR-11): one run or a filtered set.

metric.description: A scalar metric: uploaded, derived or any DSL expression.

parameters.description: The compared parameters, for `dimension = parameters`.

reference.description: The reference value; default the first value.

values.description:
Values of the dimension to show, in this order. Default: all values
found (runs by start time, others sorted).

case.description: The matching key: the case without compared and excluded parameters.

cells.description: Only columns with results, in column order.

client_device.description: Device name after aliases; absent when devices are compared.

occurred_at.description: A point in time, e.g. "switched to new compression".

CreateCaseExecution.description:
Adds a case execution to a running run, or a correction (`supersedes_id`)
to any run (FR-6). Samples may be sent inline or added later.

metrics.description: Definitions of the metrics used in `samples`.

supersedes_id.description:
Case execution of the same run, test case and device this one
corrects.

CreateRun.description: Creates a run (FR-1). The run starts as `running`.

shared_environment.description:
Details of the shared environment (server, backend, ...). Identical
details are stored once (fingerprint).

started_at.description: Measured start time from the harness. Trends and time filters use it.

tags.description: Tags the run is created with.

CreateSample.description: Adds one sample to a case execution.

CreateSeries.description: Adds one series to a sample.

DerivedMetric.description: A derived metric (FR-17). It has one definition, which can be changed.

updated_at.description: When the definition was last changed.

uses.description: Names of the derived metrics the expression uses directly.

resolved_name.description: Name after aliases; trends and comparisons use this.

ratio.description: Mean divided by the reference mean (normalization, FR-13).

relative.description:
`absolute` divided by the absolute reference mean; absent if the
reference mean is 0.

start.description: Byte offsets of the part of the expression the message refers to.

expression.description: An ad-hoc expression. Give either this or `name`.

max_points.description: For series results: downsample to at most this many points.

unit.description: Output unit; default: the declared unit, or the expression's unit.

Excluded.description: Samples left out because the metric does not apply to them.

errors.description: Samples whose inputs do not fit the expression (e.g. units).

first_error.description: The first such error, for diagnosis.

missing.description: Samples without an input of the expression (not measured).

metric.description: A scalar metric: uploaded, derived or any DSL expression.

metrics.description:
Uploaded scalar metrics the expression needs (including through the
derived metrics it uses).

GridSpec.description:
A common x grid: `points` evenly spaced values from `from` to `to`.
Without `from`/`to` the grid covers the series (per group when
aggregating).

created.description: False if everything already existed with identical content (a retry).

KeyValue.description:
An attribute of a group key; `value` is null for the subgroup of frames
without a value.

LevelShape.description:
A group level: made by a group node (`by`, `except`) or by a match
(`inputs`).

unit.description: The unit the metric has now; the value was not converted.

MeasurementValue.description: A measured value: a number, or a boolean for boolean metrics.

Metric.description:
An uploaded metric. It has one definition, which can be changed in the
web UI.

has_results.description:
True if measurements or series of the metric are stored. Such a
metric cannot be deleted.

updated_at.description: When the definition was last changed.

used_by.description: Names of the derived metrics whose expressions refer to the metric.

MetricInput.description:
Definition of a metric used in the request. It creates the metric if
there is none with this name. A metric that exists is not changed: its
direction and description stay as they are, and the unit and value type
must be the ones it has (otherwise 409, `metric_definition_conflict`).
Metrics are changed in the web UI.

definition.description:
Free-form JSON definition. Identical definitions map to the same
version; a changed definition is a new version.

NodeShape.description: The output of a node as validation infers it.

attributes.description:
Attributes frames and points can have. `param.*` and `asset.*`
stand for every parameter and asset.

columns.description: Columns of the frames; of the frames of `a` below a match level.

grid.description: The common grid, if one was requested.

truncated.description: True if more series matched than `max_series`.

x.description: x values; absent when resampled onto the grid.

y.description: y values; null where the series has no value at a grid point.

Problem.description:
Problem details (RFC 9457). `code` is a stable, machine-readable error
code.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

RunChart.description: Runs a chart spec that is not saved (FR-22, FR-23).

oneOf.description:
Streams the data that reaches the visualization as a file instead of
events (FR-20): one row per point with its attributes and columns.

max_points.description:
Most points per line for display (at least 2, default 2000): each
frame that reaches a `line` keeps the minimum and maximum of each
bucket of its points. Other visualizations are not downsampled.

preview.description:
Limits each source to the latest run that matches its filter. The
result is marked `partial`.

until.description:
Stops at this node and returns its output instead of what reaches
the visualization (preview of a node).

variables.description:
Values of the chart's variables, by name. A variable without a value
takes its default; without one, the run is rejected.

last_upload_at.description: Last upload of anything for this run, in server time (FR-2).

RunFilter.description:
Run filters (FR-11). Filters on case executions (device, scenario, asset,
parameters, metric) match runs with at least one current case execution
that satisfies all of them. Device and parameter filters use the values
after aliases.

latest_runs.description:
Of the runs that match all other conditions, only the N (at least 1)
with the newest measured start. `limit` and `cursor` page through them.

metric.description: Metric name with a measurement or series in the run.

param.description:
Parameter filter `name=value`, repeatable. The value is read as JSON
(`size=10` is a number, `mode="10"` a string); anything that is not a
JSON scalar is a string (`mode=fast`).

since_sut_tag.description:
Measured start at or after that of the earliest run whose SUT version
has this tag, e.g. a release. Looked up among all runs, whatever the
other conditions say; 422 if no run has the tag.

since_tag.description:
Measured start at or after that of the earliest run with this run tag.
The marked run is looked up among all runs, whatever the other
conditions say; 422 if no run has the tag.

started_after.description: Measured start time at or after this time.

started_before.description: Measured start time before this time.

started_within_days.description:
Measured start within the last N days (at least 1), counted from the
server's time at the request.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

measurements.description: Metric name -> value; every metric must be defined in `metrics`.

SeriesGroup.description: Series of one run, case and device aggregated across samples.

n.description: Number of series with a value at each grid point.

SeriesInput.description: A raw, measured series: one per metric and sample. x never decreases.

metric.description: Metric name; must be defined in `metrics`.

unit.description: Unit of y (the unit the metric has now).

oneOf.description:
Resample onto this grid. Required for alignment in an overlay;
aggregation always uses a grid.

max_points.description:
Overlay without grid: downsample each series to at most this many
points (default 2000).

max_series.description: Most series in an overlay (default 500, at most 5000).

metric.description:
A series: `series.<name>`, a derived series metric or a series
expression.

x_unit.description: Unit of x; default the x unit of the most recent series.

Stats.description:
Aggregate across the samples of one run, case and device (FR-12).
Samples without a value (FR-12a) are counted in `n_no_value` and left
out of the statistics.

parameters.description:
Flat object of numbers, strings and booleans. Types are kept. Names
cannot contain a backtick (`` ` ``), which expressions use to quote
names.
Parameters as uploaded.

relative_to_reference.description: Mean divided by the reference run's mean, if a reference is set.

filter.description: Further restrictions, e.g. a time range or a branch (FR-11).

reference_run_id.description: Normalize to the mean of this run (FR-13).

test_case_id.description:
Any test case of the case. Test cases whose parameters are equal
after aliases belong to the same case; other scenario versions never
do.

annotations.description:
Annotations on the runs, on the case's test cases, and points in time
within the trend.

to_base.description:
Value in this unit times `to_base` is the value in the base unit of
the quantity.

ValidateChart.description: Checks a chart spec without running it.

spec.description:
The spec (format 1, ADR 0022). Settings that are variables are
checked with their defaults.

name.description:
Name the expression will be saved under. A reference to it, direct
or through other derived metrics, is a cycle. If the derived metric
exists, the metrics built on it are checked too: the expression is
invalid if it would break one of them.

unit.description: Unit the result must convert to.

inferred_unit.description: Unit the expression has by itself, if valid.

unit.description: Unit of the result (the declared unit if one was given), if valid.

uses.description: Names of the derived metrics the expression refers to directly.

x_unit.description: For a series: unit and dimension of x.

bearer.description: API token (trk_...) created in the web UI

tags.name: ingestion
tags.description: Incremental, idempotent upload of results (FR-1 to FR-5)

tags.name: analysis
tags.description: Aggregates, trends, comparisons, series views and export (FR-12 to FR-20)

tags.name: charts
tags.description: Run and check charts (FR-20, FR-22 to FR-25)
